facts.en: Completed a customer-service diploma at Fictional Songcopper College in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构歌铜学院完成客户服务文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid service-desk assistant at Fictional Wrenstring Instrument Workshop from 2022-05 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-05 至 2026-08 在虚构鹪弦乐器工坊任有薪服务柜台助理。

facts.en: Recorded instrument serial numbers, cases and customer-described symptoms on intake tickets.
facts.zh: 在受理票据上记录乐器序列号、乐器盒及客户描述的症状。

facts.en: Kept customer descriptions labeled as reported concerns; technicians supplied the diagnosis and proposed work.
facts.zh: 将客户描述标为报称问题；诊断及拟议维修工作由技师提供。

facts.en: Photographed visible marks at intake with customer permission and linked the photos to the ticket.
facts.zh: 经客户同意，在受理时拍摄可见痕迹，并将照片与票据关联。

facts.en: Prepared quote emails from technician-approved work descriptions and the manager’s price list.
facts.zh: 依据技师批准的维修描述及经理价目表准备报价邮件。

facts.en: Logged customer acceptance before moving a ticket to the approved-work queue.
facts.zh: 记录客户接受报价后，才将票据移至已获准维修队列。

facts.en: Booked collection windows after technicians marked the instrument ready and retained signed collection receipts.
facts.zh: 在技师将乐器标记为可取后安排取件窗口，并保留签署的取件收据。

facts.en: Revised the intake-photo checklist with the workshop manager in 2025-01.
facts.zh: 2025-01 与工坊经理共同修订受理拍照核对表。

facts.en: Personally added case-condition and serial-label photo fields; technicians defined the instrument-condition prompts.
facts.zh: 个人添加乐器盒状况及序列号标签照片字段；乐器状况提示由技师定义。

facts.en: A 2025-02 review found linked intake photos in 19 of 22 sampled tickets; it did not assess repair quality.
facts.zh: 2025-02 审核发现，22 份抽样票据有 19 份关联受理照片；该审核未评估维修质量。

facts.en: Uses a repair-ticket system, shared booking calendar and approved quote templates.
facts.zh: 使用维修工单系统、共享预订日历及获批报价模板。

facts.en: Kept a list of loan-instrument return dates and asked the manager to resolve overdue returns.
facts.zh: 维护代用乐器归还日期清单，并请经理处理逾期归还。

facts.en: Completed an internal instrument-handling orientation in 2022-05; the training concerned intake and storage rather than repair technique.
facts.zh: 2022-05 完成内部乐器搬运入门培训；培训涉及受理及存放，而非维修技术。

facts.en: Plays amateur violin in Fictional Junebell Ensemble, rehearsing one evening per week since 2021-09.
facts.zh: 自 2021-09 起在虚构六月铃乐团业余拉小提琴，每周排练一个晚间。

facts.en: Tunes the candidate’s own violin and changes its strings; no paid instrument setup or repair work is recorded.
facts.zh: 为候选人本人的小提琴调音及换弦；未记录有偿乐器调校或维修工作。

facts.en: Voluntarily organized the ensemble’s instrument-case storage chart in 2024-03.
facts.zh: 2024-03 志愿整理该乐团的乐器盒存放图表。

facts.en: Helped staff a second-hand music-book table at Fictional Copperchime Fair in 2023-11, handling book labels rather than instrument appraisals.
facts.zh: 2023-11 在虚构铜铃集市协助照看二手乐谱书摊，处理书籍标签，而非乐器估价。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated practice journal in 2025 without publishing teaching materials.
facts.zh: 2025 年制作个人图解练习日记，未出版教学材料。

facts.en: Enjoys making miniature paper theatre sets.
facts.zh: 爱好制作微型纸质剧场布景。
